calamidade_awakening.configuration.scree: Bloom, flashes, contrast, desaturation, aberration, vignette, grain, zoom blur, afterimage, atmosphere exposure and ambient tint from this mod and its addons. 0 turns them off.
calamidade_awakening.configuration.camer: Screen shake from this mod and its addons.
calamidade_awakening.configuration.motio: Zoom blur and afterimage trails from this mod and its addons. Turn off if they cause motion sickness.
calamidade_awakening.configuration.vanil: Atmosphere fog through the game fog
Recommended. Terrain, entities, particles, water and clouds are fogged at their real distance. Turn off only if a shader pack ignores the game fog: the mod then draws the fog on the screen.

calamidade_awakening.configuration.terra: Terrain (Terrain API)
Craters, burnt shells and blocks placed by effects. Conservative defaults.
Terrain edits
Turns every terrain edit of the effects on or off.
Largest volume per edit
Most planned blocks in one edit (carved, shell, fill, structure). Larger edits are refused.
Blocks per tick
Blocks written per server tick, shared by the running edits. An edit may ask for less.
Allowed dimensions
Dimensions where edits run ("*" for all).
Allow replacing blocks with a block entity
Edits that explicitly ask for it may replace chests, furnaces and blocks of other mods (their contents go to the undo snapshot).
Respect mobGriefing
Edits started by a mob follow the mobGriefing game rule.
Minutes to undo
How long an edit can be undone with /calamidade terrain undo (0 keeps no snapshot).
Snapshots kept
Most undo snapshots kept (the oldest go first).
Largest structure
Largest .nbt structure an edit may place, blocks per axis.
Go through the explosion event

Every edit also goes through NeoForge's explosion events: protection mods (claims, regions) that protect against explosions protect against craters. Off: only TerrainEditEvent, world border and spawn protection.
Respect spawn protection
Edits leave the spawn protection area (spawn-protection in server.properties) intact; an operator is exempt only when the edit is theirs.
